decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to the appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed works, due to their compatible design, siting and appearance, would not harm the architectural or historic interest of the listed building. The proposal is therefore acceptable and would accord with ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to listed buildings and buildings of local townscape character).

Condition : 2 - Detailed drawings or samples of materials, as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to commencement of the work:
(a)	Details and specification of internal partitioning.
(b)	Details and specification vent grilles and soil pipeSuch details shall be implemented only in accordance with the drawings as approved.

Condition : 4 - No further alterations shall be implemented (e.g. as may be required by Building Regulations) without confirmation from the Local Planning Authority as to whether Listed Building Consent is required.
description: Conversion of an internal room into toilet accomodation with external drainage and ventilation grilles to external wall (Listed Building Consent)
